sources.note: A review of the 23-fault models ran six candidate faults; all passed their checker (review-before/). Isabelle gained destination lemmas for the four operations without one, each stating the destination mode, the recorded trace (including output commands) and the bed (unchanged, or swapped on changeover completion). The CSP suite gained an untimed command protocol, ADS_CommandNormal [FD= ADS_CommandView, over the four inputs and four output commands (23 assertions). The Java Actuator records its command history and the dewpoint test asserts RaiseAlarm then StartChangeover. The candidates are now faults I7-I9, F5-F6 and J5. One run passes all five baselines, detects all 29 faults and passes all six controls; both scenarios keep their outcomes. These faults were exposed by review; the total is not an independent estimate.
